title: Moment Western Australian divers surface to see their boat had disappeared caught in footage
summary: Ryan Chapman and a friend survived 90 minutes in the ocean before being picked up by a passing boat – and carrying on with their dive Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Two divers have survived becoming stranded in the ocean after losing their boat while diving in a popular fishing spot in Western Australia. Ryan Chapman and his mate were free diving and scuba diving about 5km off Mindarie, a coastal suburb north of Perth, when they resurfaced to find their boat had disappeared. Continue reading...

title: Israel poised to start construction of bypass through heart of West Bank
summary: Road project, part of blueprint for new illegal settlement in E1 area east of Jerusalem, is considered a tool of annexation Israel plans to start work next month on a bypass road that will close off the heart of the occupied West Bank to Palestinians and cement the de facto annexation of an area critical for the viability of a future Palestinian state. The road is a key part of the blueprint for a vast illegal new settlement in the E1 area east of Jerusalem, which would fragment the occupied West Bank. The Israeli finance minister, Bezalel Smotrich, said the plans were intended to “bury the idea of a Palestinian state”. Continue reading...

title: Government’s wildlife targets will be missed in England, watchdog says
summary: Seven out of 10 targets have little likelihood of being met by 2030, Office for Environmental Protection says The government will not meet its targets to save wildlife in England and is failing on almost all environmental measures, the Office for Environmental Protection watchdog has said. In a damning report, the OEP has found that seven of the 10 targets set in the Environment Act 2021 have little likelihood of being met by 2030, which is the deadline set in law. Continue reading...

title: Central Banks Work on Statement in Solidarity With Fed’s Powell
summary: Global central bank officials are working on a statement to show solidarity with Chairman Jerome Powell after the Trump administration dramatically escalated its pressure campaign toward the Federal Reserve, according to a person familiar with the matter.

title: Iran’s Islamic Republic is in its ‘Final Days,’ Predicts Germany’s Merz
summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz became the first Group of Seven leader to predict the downfall of Iran’s regime in the face of mass protests, saying it’s in its “final days.”
